## Summary

- **generate-pipeline**: Wrap the internal `/api/image-generation` fetch in try/catch so network failures return a structured `{ok: false, error: ...}` 502 response instead of an unhandled exception bubbling up to SvelteKit's raw error handler.
- **generate-pipeline**: Remove dead `|| 502` fallback on `imageResponse.status` — `Response.status` is always a number on a successful network call, so the `||` branch was unreachable.
- **http-client**: Include the HTTP status code in the `postJson` JSON-parse error message to make debugging non-JSON error responses (e.g. a 503 with an HTML body) significantly easier.
- **+page.svelte**: Remove `console.error` that logged the internal `actionId` when a studio text action lookup failed — the error is already surfaced to the user via `textError`, and the console call leaked internal state to browser devtools.

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify `npm run build` still passes
- [ ] In the generate flow, confirm a normal generation still works end-to-end
- [ ] Confirm that killing the image-generation service returns a structured 502 JSON error (rather than a raw 500 page)
- [ ] Confirm no console.error fires when an invalid actionId is dispatched from the studio

## Summary by Sourcery

Improve robustness and observability around image generation and studio text actions while removing minor dead code and debug logging.

Bug Fixes:
- Handle failures when calling the internal image-generation API by returning a structured 502 error instead of letting exceptions bubble up.
- Ensure generate pipeline error responses use the actual HTTP status from the image-generation service without an unreachable fallback.
- Avoid leaking internal studio action identifiers to the browser console when a text action lookup fails.

Enhancements:
- Include the HTTP status code in postJson JSON-parse error messages to make debugging non-JSON HTTP responses easier.
